description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the AWS Signer service, providing methods for various signer-related operations.

classes.name: signerClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Signer service, extending the generic AwsClient class.

methods.name: addProfilePermission
methods.description: Adds a permission to a signing profile.

methods.name: getRevocationStatus
methods.description: Gets revocation status for a signature.

methods.name: getSigningPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves information about a signing platform.

methods.name: getSigningProfile
methods.description: Retrieves details of a signing profile.

methods.name: listProfilePermissions
methods.description: Lists permissions of a signing profile.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: putSigningProfile
methods.description: Creates or updates a signing profile.

methods.name: removeProfilePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission from a signing profile.
